svg.title: Hierarchical Music-to-Motion Matching and Beat-Synchronous Humanoid Control
svg.desc: An academic model diagram with three panels: music representation, hierarchical music-to-motion matching, and motion synthesis and control.
svg.text: Hierarchical Music-to-Motion Matching and Beat-Synchronous Humanoid Control
Realtime Humanoid Matcher for AIST++ Retrieval, Motion Transition, and Unitree G1 Kinematic Playback

g.text: 16 kHz mono · DC removal · 95th-percentile gain normalization
6 s rolling window · retrieval every 1 s
accepted beats · RMS · onset · brightness · frequency bands
same preprocessing and encoders → standardized catalog feature bank
weights renormalized to .70 : .20 when tags are unavailable
Top-3 Segment Mean Pooling per Track
segment scores → music-level retrieval score Smusic
switch only at a 4-beat bar boundary
search keypoint neighborhoods (±3 frames); transition duration quantized to half-beats
strong-beat selection · tempo adaptation · gradual phase-error correction
joint interpolation · root-position blend · quaternion SLERP
joint speed / acceleration constraints · runtime self-collision check
kinematic playback via mj_forward (not torque or balance control)

svg.text: Current catalog: DSP embedding, 348 audio segments, 60 music tracks, and 411 preflight-passed AIST++ motions
Blue panels: representation and retrieval · Orange panel: selection, transition, safety, and humanoid output
